source_ancestry.curated: Unchanged FastChem H2K2O2 fit labelledJANAF1998; underlying official evaluation December1970.
source_ancestry.old_thermal: JANAF1974p447 C2h sigma2; K2F2 core-frequency analogy and Li-dimer OH-frequency estimates.
source_ancestry.new_thermal: Gurvich1997pp1059-1062 D2h sigma4; four matrixIR frequencies, six ionic-model frequencies,two estimatedOH stretches. Electron diffraction supports structure but numerical inconsistency noted in evaluation.
source_ancestry.new_energy: Gusarov1968 and Hastie1984 potassium-specific vapor measurements plus auxiliary KOH(cr/g) references; Na/K exchange is additional and correlated, not sole basis.

numeric_interpretation.energy_alignment: Balanced reaction H298 diagnostic only; source difference persists and increases after removing energy compensation.
numeric_interpretation.association: 2KOH(g)->dimer changes both source monomers and dimer; not dimer-only replacement.
numeric_interpretation.phase_reaction: Selected H0=+16+/-3kJ/mol for KOH(cr)+KOH(g)->dimer; distinct from gas association/totalatomization.
numeric_interpretation.reconstructed_pressure: Thirdlaw totalpressure points share selected16kJ/mol intermediate reaction and are not independent confirmations.
numeric_interpretation.uncertainty: Prose Hf298 -641+/-8kJ/mol; Table28 at0/300K lists9. Preserve scopes/values; no probabilistic propagation.
numeric_interpretation.standard_pressure: Current comparisons1bar. Atomformation DeltaNu=-5: converting1atm to1bar shifts lnK by -5ln1.01325, not ordersofmagnitude.

decision.reason: Potassium-specific spectroscopy and vapor analysis replace obsolete estimated thermal construction; preference is conditional, not physicalaccuracy certification.
decision.next_candidate: Define consistent atomic references, check thermodynamic identities and focused fixed-network dimer-only substitution. All original old papers need not precede candidate evaluation.
